sections.text: Ember Station is drifting toward a solar flare. A broken emergency signal repeats from somewhere beyond the airlock.

consequence.text: A loose panel strikes your suit.
An emergency patch treats your injuries.

sections.text: The gantry reaches a reactor access door. A narrow service route also leads to the communications room.

consequence.text: Superheated air burns through your glove.

options.description: Take the service route to communications

sections.text: The medical bay has one working diagnostic screen. Its map shows a safe route to communications and a return passage to the airlock.
The signal needs power from the reactor relay. An escape shuttle remains connected to the station.
A manual switch can restore the relay. The shuttle passage is filling with hot vapor.
The relay comes alive. You can transmit from behind its shield, or attempt a dangerous external antenna repair.

consequence.text: The flare overwhelms your suit shielding.

sections.text: Your signal reaches a nearby freighter. Rescue lights appear beyond the station windows.
The shuttle carries the station's logs away from the flare. A patrol vessel answers your distress beacon.
